deep.reconstruction:
Context. On the previous page Grothendieck built a group Σ. It is an extension of S3×Z/2 by the group generated by the loops l0, l1, l∞ (with l∞l1l0=1). Here S3×Z/2 is the full holomorphic-plus-antiholomorphic symmetry group of (P^1, {0,1,∞}). The lifted generators are:
- σ0, σ1, σ∞: lifts of the transpositions;
- ρ: a lift of the 3-cycle;
- τ0, τ1, τ∞: three involutions lifting complex conjugation.
The loops are products of adjacent τ's, e.g. l0 = τ∞τ1. So the τ's generate Z/2*Z/2*Z/2, whose index-2 subgroup ⟨l's⟩ is free of rank 2, i.e. π1(P^1−{0,1,∞}).

What this page does. Since σ1 = ρσ0ρ^{-1}, σ∞ = ρ²σ0ρ^{-2}, τ1 = ρτ0ρ^{-1} and τ∞ = ρ²τ0ρ^{-2}, the group needs only the three generators ρ, σ0, τ0. The relations become:
1) σ0² = τ0² = 1 and σ0τ0 = τ0σ0, i.e. σ̃0 := σ0τ0 is an involution;
2) ρ³ = 1;
3) a single 'mixed' relation, obtained by rewriting σ0σ1 = τ∞τ1ρ in the three generators. The other two relations of this type are its ρ-conjugates.
Grothendieck simplifies (3) to [ρ,σ0] = [τ0,ρ^{-1}], i.e. [ρ,σ0][ρ^{-1},τ0] = 1.

Conclusion drawn. Σ is the quotient of the free product (Z/2×Z/2)*Z/3 by the normal subgroup generated by one relator.

Remark on symmetry. He notes the presentation has an automorphism σ0↔τ0, ρ↔ρ^{-1}, which therefore also swaps σ1↔τ∞ and σ∞↔τ1. He observes it does not respect the extension structure. Its image in S3×Z/2 would have to preserve the centre, generated by the image of the τ's, yet it sends τ0 to σ0.

Interpretation. Σ is (up to the conventions for the lifts) the orbifold fundamental group of (P^1−{0,1,∞})/(S3×Z/2). That is the normaliser of Γ̄(2) in Isom(H), i.e. the extended modular group PGL2(Z) ≅ D2 *_{Z/2} D3. Two consistency checks support this:
- With the corrected relation, the abelianisation is Z/2×Z/2, as for PGL2(Z).
- The symmetry fixes σ̃0 = σ0τ0 (the element he overbraced) and swaps the other two involutions of the Klein group. This is exactly the shape of the standard outer automorphism of an amalgam D2 *_{Z/2} D3 that fixes the amalgamated involution.

The page serves the genus-0 'Teichmüller tower / Lego' program. The next page goes on to the extension SΓ_{0,3} of Γ by Z^{0,1,∞} (boundary twists).
errors: Algebra slip in the mixed relation. ρ²τ0ρ^{-2}·ρτ0ρ^{-1}·ρ = ρ²τ0ρ^{-1}τ0 = ρ^{-1}τ0ρ^{-1}τ0, not ρ^{-1}τ0ρτ0 as written. The correct relation is ρσ0ρ^{-1}σ0 = τ0ρτ0ρ, i.e. [ρ,σ0] = τ0ρτ0ρ, which is not of the form [τ0,ρ^{-1}].

Consequence: the final relator [ρ,σ0][ρ^{-1},τ0]=1 is wrong. Under it ρ survives in the abelianisation (giving Z/3×Z/2×Z/2). But the original relation σ0σ1 = τ∞τ1ρ forces ρ ↦ 1 in the abelianisation, and the true abelianisation is Z/2×Z/2.
The symmetry σ0↔τ0, ρ↔ρ^{-1} still holds for the corrected relator. It sends the relator to a cyclic permutation of its inverse, so the NB remark survives the slip.
The 'one-relator over (Z/2)²*Z/3' description is correct in form once the relator is fixed. The page does not verify that the resulting kernel over S3×Z/2 is really free of rank 2.

ideas.what: Reducing the presentation of the extension of S3×Z/2 to generators ρ, σ0, τ0 and one relator over the free product (Z/2×Z/2)*Z/3
ideas.modern_name: Presentation of PGL2(Z) / extended modular group as an orbifold π1 of (P^1−{0,1,∞})/(S3×Z/2)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Klein, Fricke; PGL2(Z) ≅ D2*_{Z/2}D3, e.g. in Serre's 'Trees')
ideas.where_published: Related material on genus-0 Teichmüller groups and PSL2(Z) appears in Esquisse d'un programme (1984) and La Longue Marche (1981); this exact presentation: unsure

ideas.what: Using lifts of complex conjugation τ0, τ1, τ∞ (involutions) so that the loops l_i are products of reflections and l∞l1l0=1 holds automatically
ideas.modern_name: Real structure / Galois action of Gal(C/R) on π1 with tangential base points; reflection presentation of π1 ⋊ Z/2
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (reflection groups); in the arithmetic setting: Ihara, Nakamura and others on complex conjugation in GT
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses complex conjugation and the Teichmüller tower in general terms

ideas.what: Automorphism σ0↔τ0, ρ↔ρ^{-1} of the group that does not preserve the normal subgroup π1 (the extension structure)
ideas.modern_name: Outer automorphism of PGL2(Z) ≅ D2*_{Z/2}D3 not preserving Γ̄(2)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Known in the literature on automorphisms of PGL2(Z) / amalgams (exact attribution unsure)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine working computation of a presentation of what is essentially the extended modular group PGL2(Z) in the genus-0 Lego/Teichmüller context. It contains a small algebra slip. The outer-symmetry observation is classical in content, and nothing here seems absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: The displayed simplification on the image does read ρ^{-1}τ0ρτ0, but this is Grothendieck's own slip, not a transcription error. The correct expression is ρ^{-1}τ0ρ^{-1}τ0.
'puis sous-groupe invariant' likely reads 'par le sous-groupe invariant' (quotient by the normal subgroup).
The marginal addition above 'seuls gén.' appears to be 'σ0, τ0' (possibly with tildes) rather than 'σ0, τ∞'; it is uncertain.
